CustomField.formula: IF(AND(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Lab__c), !ISBLANK(Required_for_Scanner__c), TEXT(Required_for_Dental_Product__c) != ""), "Lab and Device and Product", IF(AND(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Lab__c), TEXT(Required_for_Dental_Product__c) != ""), "Lab and Product", IF(AND(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Lab__c), !ISBLANK(Required_for_Scanner__c)), "Lab and Device", IF(AND(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Scanner__c), TEXT(Required_for_Dental_Product__c) != ""), "Device and Product", IF(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Lab__c), "Lab", IF(!ISBLANK(Required_for_Scanner__c), "Device", IF(TEXT(Required_for_Dental_Product__c) != "", "Product", IF(Required_for_Downgraded_Device__c, "Downgraded Device", IF(Required_for_Lab_Only__c, "Lab Only", "None")))))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determine which requirements are populated; used for automating
CustomField.label: Requirements
